title: Don Pasquale (sérénade)
doubts: Serenade taken to be Ernesto's 'Com'è gentil' (Act III), inferred; 071.0225 listed in the batch is not the opera (racehorse in the 10 May 1877 race card, 071.0226-0231); bare alias 'Don Pasquale' avoided.

title: Les Noces de Jeannette
doubts: Venue of 069.0286 (13 Mar 1877) not stated in the paragraph; plausibly the Neapolitan Philharmonic, hedged. 069.0527 is Melito's remark at the 25 Mar Philharmonic concert.

title: L'Africaine
doubts: 068.1105 'ne fais pas l'Africaine' is a figure of speech, not the opera; only 077.0140 (9 Jan 1878, Opéra) is the work. No free libretto found beyond IMSLP.

title: Rienzi (Wagner)
doubts: 063.0443 (17 Jul 1876) is Bulwer-Lytton's Rienzi (existing RIENZI_BULWER_LYTTON tag correct), not Wagner; only 071.0083 (Florence, Pagliano, 1 May 1877) is the opera. Language of the Florence performance not stated.

title: Roméo et Juliette (opera)
doubts: 059.0193 = Marchetti's Romeo e Giulietta (Apollo, Rome, Lent 1876; libretto printed for that season; confidence ~0.85, per existing RSR). 064.0141 is Cassagnac speaking of Shakespeare's lovers, not the opera. Entry has no bare 'Roméo et Juliette' alias, so 059.0193 needs a manual tag. Not Gounod, not Bellini.

title: Le Rossignol che vola
doubts: Real Niçois traditional song (BnF recording 1939 'Lou roussignol qué vola', ronde de mai; Bozza op.43/4 listed on LiederNet). In 054.0030, 055.0685-0686 the title is also used as a nickname/prize name for Audiffret. No free full text found; none linked. Merged by the lead into LE_ROSSIGNOL_CHE_VOLA (batch 04 wrote the same song).

title: Vivre seul ici-bas
doubts: Composer/poet not identified despite web search; entry rests on Marie's paraphrase (078.0061, 078.0084). Title also appears as 'seule'.

title: Si j'étais reine (mélodie de Caen)
doubts: Existing proper entry under culture/music enriched in place (id kept; name changed to the song title; bare alias 'Caen' removed because it would mis-tag). Author/title unidentified; no full text. 080.0526-0548 is the copied text.

title: Simon Boccanegra
doubts: Theatre of the Paris performance not stated in the diary; revised 1881 version, first Paris performance 27 Nov 1883 per the source footnote.

title: La Muette de Portici
doubts: 086.0224 = Opéra, 8 Sep 1879, 'la première' read as first night of the revival (hedged); 087.0684 recalls its Neapolitan sets.

title: Le Roi de Lahore
doubts: Opera identification probable, not stated in the print; 'Incantation' (083.0580) not identified with a number of the opera. Image: Vierge/Gillot 1877 drawing of Act III, public domain via Commons.

title: L'oiseau s'envole
doubts: Identified: refrain of a number from Massé's Paul et Virginie (1876); entry cross-links PAUL_ET_VIRGINIE_MASSE. Dates: 082.0068/0080 are 13 Aug 1878 (Soden), not Sept. Street song 'Quand les canards vont tous en tas' (082.0081) remains unidentified.

title: Hymne russe
doubts: Identification as Lvov's God Save the Tsar! (1833) is certain for the period. Alias 'hymne russe' could in principle mis-tag a generic mention.

title: Faust: Ah je ris de me voir si belle
doubts: Jewel Song entry created for 024.0102. 011.0153 ('la légende de Faust') is the Thulé ballad: added to IL_ETAIT_UN_ROI_DE_THULE (new bullet, alias 'légende de Faust', last_updated), not the Jewel Song. Existing FAUST.md left unedited.
